'''Arien''' is a village on the [[Caemlyn Road]] in [[Andor]] between [[Whitebridge]] and [[Four Kings]]. It is the next village east of the [[Else Grinwell|Grinwell]] farm, being a full day's walk away.{{ref/book|1|31}}

[[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Mat Cauthon]] passed through Arien on their way to [[Caemlyn]], and performed at the village's only inn in return for dinner and bed. The next morning they were given a lift for several miles down the road by cart-driver [[Eazil Forney]].{{ref/book|1|31}}
